title: Office Battlefield - Negative-Sum Game
summary: Jason calls his workplace feud a negative-sum game, then questions the payoffs he invented. He realizes that anger, not strategy, drove his need to humiliate Jamin, and that trust and friendship were costs his model missed.

portal.scene: Jason faces a chess table and a ledger marked time, trust, and friendship, surrounded by office records and unanswered questions.
portal.motif: The cost of the wrong game
